request.spec:
Anyone using the app first signs in by typing a name; there is no password. The signed-in
name shows on the screen. A sheet is chosen by typing its id and loading it; the active sheet id
shows on the screen, and everything else in the app is kept per sheet. A sheet that has never been
loaded before starts empty. Everything happens on the one screen at /.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Anyone using the app first signs in by typing a name; there is no password. The signed-in
name shows on the screen. A sheet is chosen by typing its id and loading it; the active sheet id
shows on the screen, and everything else in the app is kept per sheet. A sheet that has never been
loaded before starts empty. Everything happens on the one screen at /.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Sign-in and sheet loading work, and `bin/e2e` passes. The test signs in two users (uma and vic) on the same sheet and checks that each one's name and the sheet id show after re-loading.

**What it does**
- **Sign-in:** you type a name, with no password. Your name then shows in `current-user`, next to a sign-out button. Submitting a blank name shows `signin-error`.
- **Choosing a sheet:** you type an id into `sheet-id-input` and press `sheet-load`, and the active id shows in `sheet-current-id`. Loading an id that has never been used starts an empty sheet. Loading an id again throws away what the screen had cached and reads it fresh from the store. A blank id shows `sheet-load-error`.
- **Storage:** a new `sheet` table (`V1__sheet.sql`) records each id and who first loaded it. A new endpoint, `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/open`, adds the sheet the first time and returns it every time, built as OfficeFloor steps the way DESIGN.md describes.
- **Where things live:** the signed-in name and the active sheet id are kept in the page URL (`?user=…&sheet=…`), as the app's conventions ask, so a browser refresh keeps them.
- **For later changes:** I added a `sheet.body` area that future per-sheet features plug into. Each one is given the sheet id and the user, and keeps its data under the same cache key, so loading a sheet again re-reads all of it.

**One decision for you:** the old empty home page had a `home-empty` anchor. AGENTS.md says existing anchors must not be removed, so I kept it on the "No sheet loaded" message, which shows after sign-in until a sheet is loaded. It no longer shows before sign-in.

The front end is in `src/main/frontend/features/session/` and `features/sheet/`, and the server code is in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/sheet/`.
